result.title: WaFIR: Wavelet-Fourier Mixture-of-Experts with Subband-Adaptive Routing for Blind All-in-One Image Restoration
result.comment: 24 pages, 15 figures, 13 tables, including supplementary material
result.summary: Blind all-in-one image restoration must adapt a shared model to heterogeneous and sometimes mixed degradations without a task label at test time. We introduce WaFIR, a decoder module that decomposes features into Haar subbands, summarizes each subband with a compact Fourier descriptor, and routes it to prompt-conditioned spectral modulation experts. Unlike image-level frequency conditioning, WaFIR makes routing decisions at the subband level, enabling frequency-specific processing while retaining the task context learned by the backbone. Under a unified training and evaluation protocol for denoising, deraining, and dehazing, WaFIR improves average PSNR over the three tasks by 0.48 dB over the PromptIR baseline and by 0.38 dB over the recent Up-Restorer. Matched-capacity and routing controls show that the gain is not explained by additional parameters alone. On unseen noise intensities, descriptor-based routing is more robust than a discrete label-conditioned alternative and remains on par under compound degradations, while routing analyses show stable subband-dependent expert use across degradation types. These results support subband frequency structure as an interpretable complement to prompt-based conditioning for blind image restoration. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/WaFIR/README.md

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 WaFIR，一个用于盲一体化图像复原的解码器模块：将特征分解为 Haar 子带，用紧凑 Fourier 描述子概括每个子带，并在子带级路由到由 prompt 条件化的谱调制专家；在去噪、去雨、去雾的统一协议下评估，并给出路由分析。
AI.relevance_reason: 以连续描述子而非离散任务标签驱动 MoE 路由、并在未见强度下更稳健的设计，可供核查是否能启发 LVR 中依据内部视觉状态做证据筛选与动态调用专家；但该工作属低层复原，缺乏推理状态，迁移性待判断。
